component.name: Claude Science Desktop
component.summary: Unofficial desktop window for Claude Science

description.p: An unofficial, community-built desktop window for Claude Science. It starts the local claude-science daemon, signs you in, and renders its web UI in a native window instead of a browser tab.

This application is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Science" are trademarks of Anthropic PBC, used here only to describe which program this wrapper opens.

No Anthropic code is included. Claude Science is downloaded from Anthropic's own servers during installation and verified against the checksum Anthropic publishes. Using it requires accepting Anthropic's terms.

ul.li: Starts and stops the local daemon, or reuses one you already run
Handles the single-use login link so there is no sign-in click
Keeps the local UI and its HTML previews in-app, external links in your browser
Verifies the daemon's SHA-256 before it is ever executed
